source.notes: Stage-1 RAM demo (single-unit): haul-truck overload decision under load-exponent and price uncertainty. Two trucks — nominal (240 t) and overloaded (300 t, +25%) — share ONE per-realization draw of the load exponent beta ~ Triangular(2.5, 3.0, 4.0), so the comparison is apples-to-apples on the same physics. Component life is consumed at a POWER-LAW rate base_rate * (payload/rated)^beta; cumulative damage integrates in a stock and the truck FAILS via a `condition`-basis failure state machine when damage >= 1.0. base_rate = 0.2/yr calibrates nominal design life to 5 yr. At beta=3 the overload multiplier is 1.25^3 = 1.95x, so overloaded life ~ 2.56 yr — component life roughly HALVES. `uptime_*` accumulators (gated on operating status) read out time-to-first-failure; `net_npv_*` is discounted metal revenue earned before failure minus a one-time replacement cost charged by the FSM effect on failure. The headline insight: a 25% overload roughly halves life AND concentrates life *uncertainty* in the overload policy (nominal TTF is ~deterministic at 5 yr; overload TTF spreads with beta). See HAUL_FLEET_MODEL_SPEC.md sec 4 (Stage 1) and STAGE1_RAM_DEMO.md.

elements.name: Rated payload
elements.description: OEM-rated payload (tonnes). Damage is normalised to this.

elements.name: Nominal payload
elements.description: Truck A loading policy: run at rated payload.

elements.name: Overload payload
elements.description: Truck B loading policy: overload +25% to 300 t for productivity.

elements.name: Base damage rate
elements.description: Damage consumed per year at rated load. 0.2/yr => nominal life 5 yr (damage reaches 1.0).

elements.name: Discount rate
elements.description: Continuous discount rate for NPV.

elements.name: Load exponent (beta)
elements.description: Power-law load-to-life exponent. The single largest source of model uncertainty; entered as a distribution, NOT a point value. Triangular(2.5, 3.0, 4.0).

elements.name: Metal price ($/t handled)
elements.description: Realised net value per tonne handled (price x grade x recovery, normalised). Lognormal, one draw per realization.

elements.name: Damage rate (nominal)
elements.description: base_rate * (payload_nom/rated)^beta = base_rate (ratio is 1).

elements.name: Damage rate (overload)
elements.description: base_rate * (payload_ovl/rated)^beta. At beta=3 the (1.25)^3 = 1.95x multiplier roughly halves life.

elements.name: Cumulative damage (nominal)
elements.description: Miner's-rule cumulative damage; fails at 1.0.

elements.name: Cumulative damage (overload)
elements.description: Cumulative damage under the overload policy.

elements.name: Truck A failure (condition basis)
elements.description: Fails when cumulative damage >= 1.0; no repair (run-to-failure). Output: 0 = operating, 1 = failed. Charges a one-time replacement cost on failure.

elements.name: Truck B failure (condition basis)
elements.description: Fails when cumulative damage >= 1.0; no repair. Output: 0 = operating, 1 = failed.

elements.name: Operating (nominal)
elements.description: 1 while operating, 0 once failed.

elements.name: Operating (overload)
elements.description: 1 while operating, 0 once failed.

elements.name: Time to first failure (nominal)
elements.description: Integrates operating status -> years of uptime; freezes at time-to-first-failure once the truck fails.

elements.name: Time to first failure (overload)
elements.description: Time-to-first-failure under the overload policy.

elements.name: Discount factor
elements.description: exp(-disc_rate * elapsed).

elements.name: Discounted revenue rate (nominal)
elements.description: payload_nom * price * operating * discount ($/yr).

elements.name: Discounted revenue rate (overload)
elements.description: payload_ovl * price * operating * discount ($/yr).

elements.name: Discounted revenue (nominal)
elements.description: Cumulative discounted revenue earned before failure.

elements.name: Discounted revenue (overload)
elements.description: Cumulative discounted revenue earned before failure.

elements.name: Replacement cost (nominal)
elements.description: One-time replacement cost, charged by the FSM effect at failure.

elements.name: Replacement cost (overload)
elements.description: One-time replacement cost, charged by the FSM effect at failure.

elements.name: Net NPV to first failure (nominal)
elements.description: Discounted revenue minus replacement cost.

elements.name: Net NPV to first failure (overload)
elements.description: Discounted revenue minus replacement cost.
